intent: Non-blocking base classes for making outbound HTTPS/HTTP requests driven from a poll() loop, tracking each as a Transaction with its own socket, timing, and response.

objects.name: SStandaloneHTTPSManager
objects.role: owns STCPManager sockets and drives Transactions through prePoll/postPoll; usable with no Bedrock plugin

objects.name: SStandaloneHTTPSManager::Transaction
objects.role: one outbound request/response: socket, full request/response SData, timestamps, response code, scheduled start

objects.name: SHTTPSManager
objects.role: SStandaloneHTTPSManager bound to an owning BedrockPlugin

objects.name: SStandaloneHTTPSManager::initProxyAddressHTTPS
objects.role: reads HTTPS_PROXY env var once to initialize proxyAddressHTTPS

misfits.why: neither BedrockServer:: nor SQLiteNode:: is referenced anywhere in the file; unused includes coupling libstuff to the application/clustering layers
exists only to attach a BedrockPlugin& to the manager, so libstuff depends on BedrockPlugin.h - inverts the expected dependency direction
misfits.suggested_home: near BedrockPlugin, or keep in libstuff but move the BedrockPlugin coupling into a thinner adapter

misfits.why: encodes a Bedrock-specific execution-model rule inside an otherwise generic transaction constructor

name_fit.note: SStandaloneHTTPSManager fits well; SHTTPSManager less so given its BedrockPlugin dependency

location_fit.note: SStandaloneHTTPSManager is a natural libstuff networking type; SHTTPSManager pulls in Bedrock application headers

naming_quality.note: consistent; SHTTPSManager's protected `plugin` lacks the `_` prefix used by SStandaloneHTTPSManager's protected members
